title: Product Manager, Dashboard
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Vercel Dashboard, the control plane for every Vercel user, defining how developers and teams interact with Vercel from first login through daily use, across both individual accounts and enterprise organizations. You will lead the shift from what is a project listing page today to a personalized, agent-powered surface that proactively helps users ship and discover value. You will report to the Product Lead and will be located in San Francisco, CA (hybrid).

If you're based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Vercel Dashboard, the primary surface through which all Vercel customers interact with the platform
  • Define how agents operate within the Dashboard, from surfacing errors and suggesting fixes to updating code and config on behalf of users
  • Shift the Dashboard from a passive "pull" experience to a proactive "push" experience, surfacing insights, notifications, and recommended actions
  • Define the information architecture and design patterns that product area teams build within, and partner with those teams (Billing, CI/CD, Observability) to keep their experiences consistent and high-quality within the Dashboard shell
  • Collaborate with Engineering to hold an uncompromising performance bar. The Dashboard must be the fastest, most delightful surface at Vercel
  • Run experiments and measure onboarding funnel performance, feature adoption, and engagement across user segments

About You:

  • You've built and shipped developer-facing products
  • You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, cloud, or developer tools companies
  • You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple
  • You think about the product from both a human and an agent perspective. You use AI tools in your own workflow and have a point of view on how agents should interact with product surfaces
  • You have experience running experiments and working with product analytics to drive roadmap decisions

Bonus If You:

  • Have worked on platform or horizontal product teams where you set patterns that other teams adopt
  • Have an engineering background or have built software yourself
  • Have worked on onboarding, activation, or growth loops in a product-led growth context
  • Have experience with personalization frameworks or systems that adapt to user segments and lifecycle stages

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $172,000 - $258,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. 

Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

  • Privacy: Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

title: Legal Ops
description:
Headquarters: NYC or Remote (EST or CST)

About the role:

Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. This is a builder role.

You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product.

We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home.

What you will do:

  • Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals
  • Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve
  • First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires
  • Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company
  • Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes
  • Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars
  • Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths
  • Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack

About You:

  • 3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company
  • You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on
  • Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper
  • You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex.
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space
  • Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer
  • You care whether people actually use what you build

Nice to have:

  • Experience at a company navigating exponential growth
  • Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings)
  • Has used Hex
  • Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace

We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you.

 

In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

The salary range for this role is: $124,125 - $165,500. 

The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.

By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy: https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy.

Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our team evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hex-technologies-legal-ops

title: Design Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads.

Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code.

You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch.

AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself.

You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

  • Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production.
  • Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem.
  • Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads.
  • Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand problems, define success, make tradeoffs, and improve what ships.
  • Own quality after launch, including visual and interaction craft, accessibility, performance, resilience, instrumentation, and edge cases.
  • Use coding agents to explore and implement ideas quickly, while testing, debugging, and taking responsibility for what ships.

About You:

  • Your work shows what you personally identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned after launch.
  • You build production-quality web applications with React and TypeScript and can contribute confidently in a large, existing codebase.
  • You bring strong visual and interaction craft and have made technical or data-rich products understandable without removing the control advanced users need.
  • You can move between graphical interfaces, CLI workflows, API behavior, and implementation details, treating accessibility, performance, failure recovery, and instrumentation as part of the design.
  • You use customer research and product data to make decisions, communicate your reasoning clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and change direction when the evidence changes.
  • You use coding agents in your daily work, but you can explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the code they help produce.

There is no required path into this role. You may come from product design, frontend engineering, creative development, or a career that does not fit a standard title. We care about the quality of what you have shipped and the judgment behind it.

Bonus If You:

  • Have experience with developer tools, infrastructure products, model marketplaces, or observability experiences.
  • Have worked with AI models, providers, inference platforms, guardrails, or AI application tooling.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health, offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter. Learn more at calm.com.

What We Do

At Calm we believe in making relaxation, better sleep, and mindfulness accessible to the entire world, and we hope you will help us achieve our mission. The Product & Design team is responsible for delivering Calm to our customers, ensuring that it is easy to use, supports their goals, and maintains a high level of quality across web, iOS, Android platforms.

As a Senior Product Designer on our Consumer team, you'll shape experiences used by tens of millions of people to sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully. People often reach for Calm in their most vulnerable moments, so the craft of what we make (how it looks, moves, and feels) matters enormously. 

This is a builder's role in the truest sense: you'll use AI and modern prototyping tools to move from insight to interactive prototype to shipped experience, not as a shortcut on quality, but to spend less time producing and more time on the judgment and detail that make an experience great. When anyone can generate a hundred screens in an afternoon, taste and judgment are the differentiators! 

The heart of this role is balancing velocity and craft in service of making our users healthier and happier, and building intuitive, engaging and impactful experiences that drive acquisition, engagement and retention.  You'll partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing, and set the standard for craft across iOS, Android, and web.  You will be a thought leader in design, helping to establish best practices and setting the bar for exceptional product design at Calm.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end product design initiatives that cover the whole product experience (visual, interaction, motion, brand integration), to create thoughtful, high-quality user-centered mobile experiences.
  • Prototype quickly in Figma and with AI and low-code tools like Replit, Lovable, and Claude, so you can get real, testable ideas in front of people early.
  • Present your design work clearly and persuasively to cross-functional stakeholders (including senior leadership), give and take feedback well, anchoring your rationale to both user needs and business goals.
  • Maintain strong attention to detail and collaboration through engineering implementation (build and QA) and post launch-iterations, to ensure high-quality execution.
  • Use data and drive research to inform the experiences you build, and leverage performance insights to evolve your approach.
  • Champion system-level thinking (improving how the team works and evolving Calm's design system) so the whole team works faster and smarter.
  • Balance multiple projects in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high standards of execution. 

Who You Are

  • Experienced Product Designer: 7+ years of experience in UX and UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile and web applications.
  • AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in Figma for design, and already using AI and low-code tools (Replit, Lovable, Claude) to prototype and move fast, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't.
  • Technical agility: Comfortable shipping small code changes without engineering support, bridging the gap between design and engineering by personally shipping copy and UI polish directly.
  • A builder: Biased toward shipping and iterating over perfect plans. You'd rather put a working prototype in front of people than write a doc about one.
  • Data- and research-informed: You fold both qualitative and quantitative insight into your design decisions, and you measure whether the work landed.
  • A strong collaborator: A low-ego, trusted partner to Product, Research, and Engineering who makes the people around them better and helps sharpen how the team works.
  • High craft standards: A strong advocate for accessibility, consistency, visual storytelling, brand integration, and motion design to create engaging user experiences, while still maintaining velocity.
  • A clear communicator: You present your thinking persuasively to stakeholders and senior leadership, give and take feedback well, and champion an experience while staying open to being wrong.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with conversational or AI-native UX.
  • Experience working at multiple organizations, ideally including time at a consumer product in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to design and ship beautiful, functional, and user-friendly experiences.
  • Comfort shipping small copy and UI changes directly in code, without engineering support.
  • A passion for Calm's mission and a point of view on how digital products can support mental health.

Minimum Requirements

  • 7+ years in UX/UI design with 5+ within consumer mobile (and web) applications.
  • Proven experience driving user testing and research.
  • Strong foundation in interaction design, visual design, and usability best practices.
  • Experience designing and shipping mobile applications at scale.
  • Hands-on proficiency in Figma and modern AI/prototyping tools.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing to a larger design vision and strategy.

Calm uses a geographic pay model that determines salaries based on the location where an employee lives. For this position, the base pay ranges across Calm’s pay tiers is as follows: $168,000 - $245,000. The base pay range represents the low and high end of Calm’s salary range for this position. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. Exact salary will ultimately depend on multiple factors, which include the successful candidate's geographic location, skills, experience and other qualifications. Calm uses employee zip code to determine which pay range applies. This role is also eligible for equity + comprehensive benefits + 401k + flexible time off.

Calm may incorporate artificial intelligence technology to support the application review process, but rest assured that human reviewers are involved in all stages of the hiring process.

Calm is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or interview process, please contact Calm’s Recruiting team at recruitingaccommodations@calm.com. All accommodation requests will be handled confidentially and assessed on a case-by-case basis.

We believe that mental health is health, and every person should be considered in the discussion. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Calm is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. We strive to create a mindful and respectful environment where everyone can bring their authentic self to work, and experience a culture that is free of harassment, racism, and discrimination.

Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. Roles which require access to certain types of information may also require the successful completion of a drug screening.

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

About Calm

Calm is the leading mental health brand on a mission to make the world happier and healthier. Known for its flagship consumer app—ranked #1 in its category with over 180 million downloads and availability in ten languages across 190 countries—Calm helps people sleep better, stress less, and live more mindfully through content and tools from experts and beloved celebrity voices. Building on this foundation, Calm has created a broader portfolio including evidence-based solutions like Calm Health, offered through employers, health plans and providers, designed to expand access to mental health and sleep support, boost benefits engagement, and drive positive health outcomes. Today, Calm supports more than 3,500 organizations and reaches over 42 million covered lives through Calm Health. Calm has been recognized as a TIME100 Most Influential Company and one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter. Learn more at calm.com.

What You'll Do

As a Growth Product Manager on Calm's direct-to-consumer business, you'll help more people discover, adopt, and build daily habits with Calm. You'll own the growth product strategy and roadmap, accountable for driving subscriber growth, activation, revenue per user, and retention. You'll set the priorities, design and run the experiments that test them, and partner with engineering, product design, marketing, data, and research to ship what works. Your goal is to make it effortless for users to form a lasting mindfulness habit while helping Calm reach and sustain its growth goals.

As a Product Manager working on Calm’s direct-to-consumer business, you will drive measurable impact across top-of-funnel conversion, trial-to-paid transitions, user activation, and long-term retention. You will design, execute, and analyze product experiments in collaboration with engineering, design, marketing, and data science teams.

Day to day, you will:

  • Own growth strategy and roadmap: Develop and own Calm's growth product strategy and roadmap, translating company revenue, subscriber, and DAU goals into a prioritized set of bets across activation, conversion, and retention.
  • Run a high-velocity experiment program: Form sharp hypotheses, design and ship A/B tests with engineering and data science, and read results honestly — including the ones that don't win.
  • Remove friction from key journeys: Use quantitative and qualitative data to find where users drop off in onboarding, habit-building, and account flows, then test simpler paths through them.
  • Ship habit mechanics: Build the features that help users plan, track, and celebrate progress, so a first session becomes a daily practice.
  • Write PRDs that make decisions easy: Spell out the job to be done, the opportunity, success metrics, and the plan to ship and iterate — then bring engineers, designers, marketers, and leadership along as the plan changes.

Who You Are

  • A growth PM, or equivalent, who's owned the number: 4+ years in consumer product, with a track record of owning a growth metric (subscriber growth, conversion, retention) and setting the strategy to move it, across consumer mobile (iOS and Android) and web.
  • A subscription-business operator: Fluent in the economics of consumer subscription (trial and paywall conversion, LTV, churn) and how product decisions show up in them.
  • A rapid experimenter: Experienced in fast experiment design and analysis (A/B tests, holdouts, sequential testing), with the statistical judgment to know when a result is real and when it's noise.
  • Data-fluent: Adept at sourcing quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize a roadmap and make feature calls, and decisive when the data won't settle it.
  • A student of habit formation: You know what drives repeat daily usage and how to build the mechanics (streaks, reminders, progress, celebration) that turn a new user into a daily one.
  • AI-native and tooling-fluent: Highly proficient in leveraging AI tools to drive team velocity and build lasting workflows, with the judgment to know when the output is good enough and when it isn't.
  • Technically agile: Comfortable discussing complexity and tradeoffs with engineers, and able to prototype your own ideas rather than wait in a queue.
  • Exceptional at documentation and organization: You keep the experiment log, results archive, and roadmap docs in a state where anyone can find what was tested, what it showed, and what's live (so the team builds on its own learnings instead of rediscovering them.)
  • A low-ego, persuasive partner: You present your thinking clearly in writing and in the room, to stakeholders and senior leadership alike, hold positions with conviction and update them on evidence, and make Product Design, User Acquisition, Research, and Engineering better for working with you.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in subscription-based consumer tech (onboarding, paywalls, or retention initiatives).
  • Familiarity with product analytics or experimentation tools (e.g., Amplitude).
  • Experience working with or passion for the health & wellness domain. 
  • Experience in developing features that drive habit formation and lifestyle change.

Minimum Requirements

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in growth, product management, or equivalent.

Calm uses a geographic pay model that determines salaries based on the location where an employee lives. For this position, the base pay ranges across Calm’s pay tiers is as follows: $147,800 - $226,700. The base pay range represents the low and high end of Calm’s salary range for this position. Not all candidates will be eligible for the upper end of the salary range. Exact salary will ultimately depend on multiple factors, which include the successful candidate's geographic location, skills, experience and other qualifications. Calm uses employee zip code to determine which pay range applies. This role is also eligible for equity + comprehensive benefits + 401k + flexible time off.

All accommodation requests will be handled confidentially and assessed on a case-by-case basis.

title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
description:
Headquarters: remote
URL: https://www.toptal.com/

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
  • Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
  • Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
  • Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
  • Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
  • Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
  • Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
  • Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
  • Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
  • Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
  • Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
  • Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
  • Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 1-3 years of experience as an Enterprise SDR.
  • Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by Enterprise clients.
  • Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts.
  • Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
  • Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
  • Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
  • Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
  • Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business - we want self-starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
  • Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
  • Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
  • Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
  • Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
  • Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
  • Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-enterprise-sales-development-representative

title: Client Advisor
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://www.toptal.com/

Job Summary

Our Client Advisors turn inbound interest from small- and medium-sized businesses into Toptal clients. You will be the first conversation a prospective client has with Toptal. You will respond to immediate-assistance requests within five minutes, quickly understand the business problem behind the request, connect necessary Toptal specialists, and help guide the client forward through the sales process.

You will need to do a great deal in a short conversation: establish trust, diagnose the need, recognize relevant opportunities, explain Toptal’s value proposition, address concerns, and convert the business to sale. This is a high energy, consultative sales role at inbound velocity where excellence will mean running a high volume of first conversations, asking better questions than the client expected, and constantly building momentum along the right Toptal offering path.

You will need to bring clarity and articulate value across Toptal’s full portfolio: specialized talent, global hiring and payroll through HireGlobal, and our AI-driven, platform-powered, outcome-focused services offerings.

Your ownership continues after the first call. You will represent the client through technical stages, keep them engaged between conversations, and resolve issues that slow a decision. You will manage those active opportunities alongside new incoming inquiries, knowing when to bring in specialists for deeper expertise.

Our ideal candidate is ambitious, competitive, driven by client service, and pairs that drive with genuine curiosity about how businesses work. If you want to build real consultative selling skills in a fast-paced environment and be compensated for it, this is the team you want to be part of.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Discovery and Diagnosis: You will run high energy, open-ended discovery on every inbound conversation. You will quickly establish rapport, understand what prompted the client to reach out, and uncover the business objective behind the stated request. You will use this to build the necessary sales momentum to keep clients engaged, earning the right to recommend before you recommend.
  • Qualify, Manage, and Win the Opportunity: You will quickly identify what is driving the need, whether there is a real opportunity, identify the metrics that matter most to the client, and who is involved in the decision. You will explain why the relevant Toptal offering fits, address the client’s concerns, and ask for commitment. You will manage deal cycles from discovery through close and maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in our CRM.
  • Own progress after the call: You will give any necessary specialists a clear account of the client’s needs and prepare them for subsequent conversations, stay close as technical questions are resolved, and keep the client engaged through the next decision. Maintain clear next steps, timing, and blockers for each active opportunity while responding to new inbound requests.
  • Portfolio Selling: Clients rarely arrive with their full set of needs articulated. You will be responsible for understanding the client’s broader growth plans, including global hiring, EOR and payroll needs, marketing and sales growth, financial, and technology challenges, and for positioning Toptal as a strategic partner rather than a single-transaction vendor.
  • Client Experience: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. You will execute a client-centric approach across every interaction during pre-defined working hours, running rapid research on clients before outreach, asking focused questions to fill the gaps, and staying current on industry trends and the competitive landscape so that you bring a point of view to the conversation.
  • Collaboration: You will work with your team and with cross-functional partners, including matching, delivery, HireGlobal, and Toptal’s service offerings experts, to respond promptly to high-volume inbound inquiries and to bring the right expertise into a deal at the right moment. Communicating clearly over Zoom and Slack is critical.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB team improves individually and as a team. You will review your own calls, seek and act on feedback, and contribute what you learn back to the team.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our team members, and our story.
  • Begin our 1-1 sales training covering our value proposition, discovery framework, sales process, and delivery method.
  • Become acquainted with the cross-functional teams you will work with to close new business.
  • Listen to recorded client calls and identify what the advisor did well and what they missed.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, including mock calls and role-play scenarios.
  • Run an inbound conversation independently: identify the client’s need, explain the relevant offering and value proposition, handle common concerns, and ask for commitment.
  • Prepare clear briefs to bring necessary specialist teams into opportunities.
  • Begin closing new business, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully ramped and integrated into the team.
  • Complete additional vertical-specific training.
  • Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
  • Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
  • Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
  • Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Mentor new team members, helping them learn our model and pass along standard methodologies.
  • Demonstrate sustained sales and quality performance across initial conversion and continued partnership opportunities on inbound existing clients.
  • Be a reference point for the team on discovery quality and on positioning the full Toptal portfolio.
  • Become a productive, collaborative, and consistent contributor to the team.

Required Qualifications

  • 2–3 years of B2B sales experience (Account Executive, Inside Sales, Sales Development, Account Representative, or a related role).
  • Demonstrated experience converting inbound opportunities into paying customers at scale, owning the sale from first call to close.
  • Experience coordinating parallel sales opportunities, and maintaining sales momentum while other teams complete necessary work.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Full availability during your working hours to take client calls.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company, managing a high volume of clients alongside competing deadlines.
  • Exceptional time management is key to success in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Software, tech, or professional-services sales experience.
  • Exposure to a named sales methodology — MEDDPICC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar.
  • Experience selling more than one product or service line into the same account.
  • Familiarity with global hiring, EOR, or payroll concepts.
  • Fluency with modern sales tooling, including AI-assisted research, call review, and CRM workflows.

Core Competencies

  • Consultative discovery. You ask open-ended questions, listen for what is not being said, and diagnose before you prescribe. You are comfortable sitting in a question rather than rushing to a pitch.
  • Qualification discipline. You know the difference between interest and intent. You can articulate why a deal will close, who will sign, and what happens if the client does nothing.
  • Business acumen. You can hold a credible conversation with a founder or business owner about growth, hiring, cost, and risk — and connect what you sell to what they are trying to achieve.
  • Point of view. You bring insight to the conversation. You are willing to respectfully reframe a client’s thinking when their stated request isn’t the best path to their goal.
  • Client-centricity. You uncover and resolve client issues through value-based selling, and you are direct about fit when Toptal isn’t the right answer.
  • Will to win. You are naturally competitive and looking to exceed quota, not just meet it. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission, and we want our Client Advisors to make the most of it.
  • Learn-it-all mindset. You constantly seek feedback from peers and leaders, review your own calls, and share what you learn with the team.
  • Ownership. You operate as a self-directed individual contributor who takes full accountability for your pipeline and your results, while collaborating effectively with the cross-functional partners who help you win.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-client-advisor

title: Sr. UX Designer, Security
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://cribl.io/

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to help define and deliver Cribl security product experience. You will design for security practitioners across detection, alerting, investigation, triage, search, threat coverage, telemetry, and AI-assisted workflows.

This role requires a genuine security background and the ability to turn complex SOC workflows into clear, trustworthy experiences. You will partner with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and other designers to create a cohesive experience that works seamlessly with our other products across the entire Cribl platform.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Lead end-to-end design from problem framing and research through interaction design, prototyping, validation, and implementation.
  • Design workflows for detection creation and management, alert review, investigation, triage, search pivots, threat coverage, normalization, and enrichment.
  • Apply security judgment to evidence, provenance, confidence, severity, permissions, auditability, destructive actions, and operational risk.
  • Design AI-assisted and agentic experiences that make intent, context, sources, capabilities, uncertainty, and user approval clear.
  • Use Cribl’s design system and contribute reusable components, patterns, guidance, and interaction models when the work has broader value.
  • Work expertly in Figma for exploration, prototyping, documentation, collaboration, and handoff, including libraries, variables, components, variants, and tokens.
  • Partner with engineers, PMs and designers through ideation, development to support feasibility, accessibility, resilience, and high-fidelity implementation challenges.
  • Share work early and often through critiques and working sessions. Give and receive specific, constructive feedback.
  • Use research and product evidence to prioritize opportunities, evaluate concepts, and improve shipped workflows.
  • Communicate design rationale, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Required:
    • 5+ years experience designing complex B2B software, enterprise platforms, or products for technical users.
    • A security background, such as security product design, security operations, threat detection, incident response, threat hunting, detection engineering, SOC workflows, SIEM, EDR, SOAR, or a related discipline.
    • Understanding of security practitioners’ realities, including noisy signals, incomplete evidence, time pressure, and high-consequence decisions.
    • Strong product thinking and interaction-design skills, with the ability to make complex technical workflows simple without oversimplifying them.
    • Experience designing AI-assisted, agentic, conversational, or other emerging interaction models.
    • Expert Figma skills, including advanced prototyping and design documentation.
    • Demonstrated expertise working in and contributing to design systems. You know when to use existing patterns and when to extend them thoughtfully.
    • Understanding of AI tools and AI UX interaction models is required. You can design experiences where AI assists, recommends, generates, investigates, or takes action while preserving user understanding, control, and trust.
    • Experience collaborating closely with Product and Engineering in an iterative and changing environment.
    • Strong communication, facilitation, and problem solving skills, including the ability to make progress when information is incomplete.
    • A portfolio with case studies that show your role, process, decisions, collaboration, and outcomes. Candidates will be asked to present and discuss previous work.
  • Highly desired:
    • Familiarity with research tools such as Dovetail, including transcripts, tagging, themes, repositories, and insights.
    • Experience with security data, detections, alerts, investigations, threat intelligence, telemetry, data pipelines, or analytical workflows.
    • Experience designing for roles, permissions, tenants, environments, or different levels of technical expertise.
  • A plus
    • Understanding of accessible product design and inclusive interaction practices.
    • Familiarity with WCAG principles, keyboard interactions, focus management, semantic structure, color contrast, and accessible content patterns.
    • Familiarity with OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK, KQL, Sigma, detection rules, threat intelligence, or related concepts.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/cribl-sr-ux-designer-security

title: Remote Senior Packaging Designer for Consumer Goods Company
description:
Headquarters: Honduras, Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic
URL: http://pearltalent.com

Description

Work From Anywhere in LATAM

Work Schedule: EST | Flexible hours with Eastern Time overlap for stakeholder presentations

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. They're looking for the sharpest, hungriest candidates who they can consistently promote and work with over many years. Candidates we've hired have been flown out to the US and EU to work with their clients, and even promoted to roles that match folks onshore in the US.

Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for: Watch here

About the Client

A consumer products brand organization working across consumer electronics, wellness, and lifestyle categories is hiring a Packaging Designer to own packaging and visual design across its portfolio.

The client designs and ships physical products into retail, and treats packaging as a primary brand touchpoint rather than a container. Work runs on launch cycles, with external vendors and production partners involved in most projects.

About the Role

Day-to-day, the Packaging Designer leads packaging systems from concept through production, extends the brand's visual system across retail displays and campaign assets, and presents concepts to internal stakeholders and clients. Success means retail-ready packaging that holds up at print, and a visual system that stays consistent across packaging, retail, and marketing.

Core Responsibilities

Packaging Design & Production

  • Lead packaging systems from concept through production across multiple product categories.
  • Build dielines, artwork, and print-ready files that meet vendor and production specifications.
  • Review proofs and press checks to confirm structural, material, and print accuracy.
  • Track packaging projects against launch timelines and production deadlines.

Brand & Visual Systems

  • Translate brand strategy into packaging and structural design solutions.
  • Maintain visual systems that stay consistent across packaging, retail, and marketing.
  • Extend brand identities across new product lines and consumer touchpoints.

Art Direction & Retail Assets

  • Art direct product launches, packaging refreshes, and brand campaigns.
  • Design retail displays, point-of-sale materials, and supporting brand assets.
  • Keep retail-facing assets aligned with the live packaging system.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Presentation

  • Work with marketing, product development, production, and external vendors on each launch.
  • Present concepts and design rationale to internal stakeholders and clients.
  • Manage feedback cycles and turn revisions around within project timelines.

Creative Leadership

  • Mentor junior designers on packaging and production standards.
  • Review team output against brand and print-quality standards.
  • Document design standards and file conventions for reuse across projects.


Requirements

Must-Have

  • 3+ years in packaging design, brand design, or creative direction with ownership from concept through production
  • Portfolio showing at least 2–3 packaging systems that shipped to retail, covering both structural and graphic work
  • Advanced Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and Adobe InDesign for dielines, artwork, and print layout
  • Working knowledge of packaging structures, substrates, print processes, and production specifications
  • Experience designing for consumer electronics, wellness, lifestyle, or consumer packaged goods brands
  • Demonstrated development of brand identities extended across packaging, retail, and marketing touchpoints
  • C1+ English (CEFR) for presenting concepts to client-side stakeholders

Nice-to-Have

  • Adobe Dimension or Cinema 4D for 3D packaging mockups and visualization
  • Figma for brand systems and cross-functional collaboration
  • Retail merchandising and point-of-sale display design experience
  • Direct working relationships with packaging manufacturers and production vendors
  • Packaging work for global brands or international market launches


Benefits
  • Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills
  • Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere
  • Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting
  • Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy
  • Health Coverage for PH-based talents: HMO coverage after 3 months for full-time employees
  • Direct Mentorship: Guidance from international industry experts
  • Learning & Development: Ongoing access to resources for professional growth
  • Global Networking: Connect with professionals worldwide

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Application
  2. Screening
  3. Skills Assessment
  4. Topgrading Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Job Offer
  7. Client Onboarding

Ready to Join Us?

If you’re empathetic, organized, and passionate about improving patient experiences through operational excellence, this role is for you. Apply now to help make specialized healthcare more accessible to patients across the U.S.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/pearl-remote-senior-packaging-designer-for-consumer-goods-company

title: Lead Cloud Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Belarus
URL: http://epam.com

We are looking for a Lead Cloud Engineer to join our innovative team.

We are delivering a Unified Automation Platform (Internal Developer Platform) to standardize secure, repeatable infrastructure delivery across Azure and on-premises VMware using templates and golden paths. You will lead Azure automation and AKS operations and strengthen IaC/CaC engineering practices. Apply to help teams ship faster with consistent, compliant deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain Terraform/OpenTofu modules for Azure App Services, Container Apps, Function Apps, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and Postgres, following designs defined by the Azure Architect
  • Build and operate the Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) platform day-to-day: cluster/node-pool provisioning, add-on configuration (ingress, cert-manager, external-dns, monitoring, policy), and namespace/tenant onboarding
  • Implement identity wiring (managed identities, SPN/app registrations) and secrets integration (Azure Key Vault, OpenBao) for Azure workloads
  • Build and maintain Image Factory pipelines for VM and container golden images (Linux and Windows/cloudbase-init baselines, CIS hardening, image scanning)
  • Execute Configuration as Code (Ansible) playbooks for VM post-provisioning and golden-image handoff
  • Support Backstage golden-path template integration for Azure provisioning, testing generated infrastructure end-to-end
  • Troubleshoot and remediate production issues across Azure automation modules during Implementation and Adoption
  • Contribute to module testing, drift detection, and documentation per the platform's Infrastructure as Code Engine standards

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building and operating Azure infrastructure via Terraform/OpenTofu, including CI/CD-driven deployment (Azure DevOps)
  • At least 1 year of relevant leadership experience
  • Experience operating Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters in production, including networking, policy, and namespace management
  • Experience with Azure identity constructs (managed identities, SPN/app registrations) and secrets integration (Key Vault, dynamic secrets)

title: Founding Head of Sales
description:
Headquarters: Wyoming, United States
URL: http://orchard.co

About Orchard

'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract.

We have now launched it as a business in its own right, selling guaranteed organic views with product placement to brands.

This is how brands grow now. Celsius, Bloom, Cal AI and Polymarket became big because thousands of creators had the product in their videos at the same time.

The business is at multi six-figures in its first month operating from inbound. You'll build the sales side from scratch: pipeline, pricing, contracts, the first hires.

About the role

What brands buy is simple: a number of views, at one CPM, guaranteed. You'll take the machine and find every way it can be sold. Some we can see: white-label it to agencies; sell it to labels as sound seeding; sell it to retailers and CPG brands as launch momentum; sell managed supply to creator platforms in the markets they can't cover. Some we can't see, and that's where you step in. Perhaps you've got a way in at an AI lab that buys creator footage by the thousand hours, or another channel we aren't even aware of yet.

This is a high-ownership opportunity to build/run sales/growth. So you need to have built revenue from a standing start before, at an agency, a platform or your own company, and have hired and run people who sell.

Requirements

  • You MUST be DTC/ecommerce/Meta native.
  • You are comfortable being first: no marketing team, no SDR, a product whose packaging you will change.
  • You have extreme agency and can be scrappy/inventive.
  • You've personally closed $100K+ sized deals with agencies, brands or platforms, and you've hired or managed people who sell.
  • Experience selling to SaaS, ecommerce, DTC, retail and founder-led companies.
  • You know the UK and US agency and creator world well enough to get 20 meetings from your own contacts in month one.

Benefits

  • £65,000 - £95,000 base + commission
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 6% pension contribution
  • Travel budget for meetings, US trips included
  • Remote first, with a London desk when you want one

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/orchard-founding-head-of-sales

title: Documentation Engineer II
description:
Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

As a Documentation Engineer II, you will be responsible for the creation and maintenance of documentation related to company products, processes, and training materials. This role involves collaborating with various teams to ensure that information is accurate, accessible, and effectively supports internal and external users.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Become a Storyblok and headless CMS authority, helping developers, partner agencies, and customers to understand Storyblok and its capabilities, implement a headless architecture on their projects easily, and get the best out of Storyblok’s features.
  • Help developers understand and get value out of Storyblok by creating and maintaining developer tutorials, developer guides, FAQ entries, and API documentation.
  • Write sample applications, prototypes, and code samples to showcase the power and flexibility of Storyblok and the headless approach to content management.
  • Helping teammates overcome obstacles, resolving blockers, and completing work tasks.
  • Seeking guidance to increase your own experience. Sometimes mentoring teammates in an open, respectful, flexible, and empathetic manner.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience in web development.
  • Proven experience in technical writing and documentation.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with CMS in general; experience with Headless CMS is a plus.
  • Thorough knowledge of consuming RESTful APIs. GraphQL APIs is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of at least one of the modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Vue, React, Next, Nuxt, Astro, or Svelte) along with its fundamental principles.
  • Working knowledge of Git.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Good problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Continuous learning mindset to stay updated on industry trends and best practices in documentation.
  • Ability to learn and document technical topics efficiently and comprehensively.
  • Ability to assume the users’ perspective to convey technical information clearly.
  • Ability to work independently with little direct supervision.
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here.

All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain (storyblok.com).

Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor

If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com

title: Senior Risk Associate
description:
Headquarters: Remote

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 

We are hiring a Senior Risk Associate to run Lithic's risk assessment function: the client risk assessment program, the third party risk management program, and the enterprise risk assessment. You will execute the assessments, own the operations that keep them on schedule and defensible, and continuously improve the rubrics, questionnaires, registers, and SOPs that govern them. You will also own program underwriting: the criteria, limit and reserve recommendations, and periodic reassessment that follow a client from diligence through scale.

This is an AI-forward role. Lithic is deploying agentic tooling across diligence and documentation workflows, and this role owns that build in the assessment domain: testing, tuning, and documenting the tooling so routine collection, review, and drafting are absorbed by automation, while you own the judgment calls, the exceptions, and the written product that goes to partner banks and examiners.

This role operates with limited guidance and owns its programs end to end. It is sized for ownership, orchestration, and judgment rather than queue/ticket processing.

What you'll do:

  • Execute client risk assessments end to end: document collection, interviews, scoring against the weighted risk typologies, written assessment, tier determination, and pre-launch conditions.
  • Own program underwriting: apply and maintain underwriting criteria, recommend spend, transfer, and reserve limits, and reassess programs as volume, product mix, and financial condition change.
  • Run third party risk operations: vendor intake and tiering, due diligence and certification report review, control effectiveness ratings, the vendor risk register, annual reviews, and vendor issue and incident tracking.
  • Support the enterprise risk assessment and the risk register: maintain the assessment inventory and calendar, collect and test control evidence, apply the enterprise rating methodology consistently across sub-assessments, and prepare Enterprise Risk Committee materials.
  • Continuously improve the programs: refine rubrics, weights, questionnaires, and templates based on observed outcomes, and author and maintain the SOPs that make each assessment repeatable by someone other than you.
  • Test, deploy, and tune agentic tooling across the assessment workflows, including document review, questionnaire analysis, vendor due diligence, and drafting, and document the context that makes the output repeatable and defensible.
  • Define and report the KPIs and KRIs for the assessment programs, and surface concentration, trend, and thematic findings to leadership and oversight forums.
  • Serve as the evidence owner for partner bank, audit, and examiner requests touching client, third party, and enterprise risk assessment.
  • Mentor and cross-train teammates on assessment methodology, scoring discipline, and the tooling.

What you'll bring:

  • Hands-on experience conducting risk assessments in fintech, payments, or banking, across client or counterparty, third party or vendor, and enterprise or operational risk.
  • Working knowledge of underwriting fundamentals: financial statement review, liquidity and runway analysis, loss and exposure monitoring, and limit setting.
  • Fluency with rubric-based scoring methodologies and the discipline to apply them consistently and defend a rating.
  • A track record of owning discrete risk programs end to end with limited guidance, including authoring the SOPs and defining the metrics that govern them.
  • Ability to read control reports (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS AOC) and translate findings into a residual risk position and a remediation ask.
  • Comfort working with AI-assisted or agentic tooling, including how to test, tune, document, and defend AI-assisted decisions to bank partners and regulators
  • Self-starter who can create structure where none exists and knows when to escalate and collaborate
  • Clear, concise writing under a compliance standard: assessments, memos, and committee materials that hold up in front of a partner bank or an examiner.

The annual US salary range for this role is $86,000 - $144,000, plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 

Benefits for Full-Time US Employees:

  • Unlimited PTO
  • 12-weeks fully paid parental leave
  • 4-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5-year anniversary)
  • Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4-weeks each year
  • 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account
  • Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match
  • 401(k) match
  • Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD

NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.

In-office employees receive: 

  • Commuter benefit
  • Catered lunch every Tuesday and Thursday

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lithic-senior-risk-associate
