title: Director of Product Marketing - USA
description:
Headquarters: Remote

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

As the Director of Product Marketing at Storyblok, We're looking for a Product Marketing Director to shape how we position, launch, and grow our product in the market- particularly in the US, UK and EMEA. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can translate complex technical capability into compelling, credible narratives — and who's comfortable in the room with engineers as much as with executives. You'll own the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing at a stage where positioning decisions have outsized impact on growth.

You will guide a talented team, focusing on sales enablement, website conversion, feature adoption, and Storyblok’s market positioning with industry analysts and customer review platforms. A key responsibility is to elevate our product marketing function to influence revenue, customer acquisition, and market leadership.

Your mission is to enable Storyblok to win in the market by clearly articulating our value, differentiation, and future direction.

What you’ll bring:

You're genuinely comfortable operating in technical territory, not just translating it secondhand. You can read API documentation, understand headless CMS architecture, and hold a credible, detailed conversation with engineers and technical evaluators about how the product actually works — its components, integration points, and trade-offs versus alternative approaches. This fluency shows up in the quality of your messaging: you write positioning that developers trust because it's accurate, not just persuasive. 

You've likely worked hands-on with developers before, whether as a technical product marketer, solutions engineer, technical product manager, or in an engineering-adjacent role, and you know how to earn credibility with a technical audience rather than assume it.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Product Positioning & Messaging

  • Own and evolve our core messaging and differentiated value proposition across all audiences (developers, marketers, partners, enterprise buyers), setting the strategic framework the wider team executes against
  • Direct ongoing customer, market, and competitive research programs to ensure messaging stays relevant, differentiated, and current
  • Set the standard for translating product capabilities and roadmap into solution-oriented, benefits-led messaging that resonates across the buyer journey
  • Ensure messaging consistency and governance across all channels — website, campaigns, sales assets, analyst briefings, and customer communications

Go-To-Market Strategy & Execution

  • Own GTM strategy for major product and feature launches, driving alignment across Product, Growth, Sales, Customer Success, and Content leadership
  • Define phased rollout strategies that drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact across key customer segments
  • Set the standard for launch toolkits — messaging frameworks, FAQs, competitive positioning, product one-pagers, internal training — and build the team capability to produce them at scale
  • Establish the measurement framework for launch performance and adoption, using it to continuously improve release execution

Sales Enablement & Sales Plays

  • Build a structured sales playbook program aligned to product capabilities, customer pain points, and vertical use cases.
  • Equip revenue teams with high-impact content (battlecards, ROI calculators, solution briefs, demo scripts, objection handling).
  • Partner directly with Sales Leadership on rep onboarding, conversion effectiveness, and keeping messaging aligned to evolving sales motions
  • Use sales performance data, win/loss interviews, and customer feedback to identify and prioritize enablement investments

Analyst & Review Site Strategy

  • Define and lead the analyst relations strategy to secure meaningful participation in key analyst evaluations (e.g., Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, IDC MarketScape).
  • Orchestrate analyst briefing cycles, submission processes, and relationships that enhance Storyblok’s visibility and influence.
  • Own our presence and growth strategy on review platforms (G2, Gartner Peer Insights), including review acquisition and profile optimization
  • Establish ongoing monitoring and response mechanisms for public reviews and rankings

Website & CRO Performance

  • Partner with Growth Marketing and Web leadership to ensure product positioning is clearly and consistently represented site-wide
  • Set priorities for CRO initiatives that improve engagement, conversion, and self-serve funnel performance
  • Define messaging strategy and success metrics for key product pages, feature highlights, and trial flows
  • Direct ongoing testing and optimization of messaging, CTAs, layouts, and journey flows based on data

Lead, mentor, and inspire the Product Marketing team to deliver high-impact outcomes aligned with company goals.

  • Set team structure, priorities, and ways of working in partnership with marketing leadership
  • Coach the team on messaging craft, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration
  • Foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning.
  • Develop individual growth plans, conduct regular performance reviews, and ensure team members have access to relevant coaching and training opportunities.
  • Ensure strong collaboration across Product, Growth, Brand, and Sales teams to drive alignment and accountability.

 

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, with at least 2+ years in a leadership role.
  • Proven experience in a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment.
  • Strong understanding of PLG motions, SaaS business models, and the product lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated success in GTM execution, analyst engagement, and pricing strategy.
  • Exceptional communication skills and executive presence.
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence.
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Marketing Automation, G2, and PMM platforms (e.g., Klue) a plus.
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.


U.S. Base Salary Range: $184,200 - $250,000

At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. title: Principal Software Engineer, AI
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Job Title: Principal Software Engineer, AI 

Location: Remote - US

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our Principal Engineer for AI sets the technical direction for how machine intelligence works across our Predictive Revenue System. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on.

This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. You will set the standards other engineers build on and act as a technical multiplier across the AI organization.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Set the technical architecture and direction for AI systems across the platform — model serving, LLM-powered features, agentic workflows, and the infrastructure beneath them.
  • Design production-grade systems that are reliable and observable despite being built on non-deterministic, probabilistic AI components.
  • Architect evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality systems that make AI behavior safe, measurable, and trustworthy at enterprise scale.
  • Lead the most complex AI engineering problems end to end — from research-adjacent prototyping through hardened production delivery.
  • Establish engineering standards and best practices for building AI-native systems, and mentor senior engineers across the org.
  • Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack.

This role lives at the heart of how we Lead From the Front: you'll work at the edge of applied AI, prototype rapidly, and make architectural bets ahead of the field. And in the spirit of how we Make Your Mark, you'll set the AI engineering standards and systems that the entire organization builds on — engineered for scale, not for a demo.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for an engineer who operates at the highest level of technical authority in AI systems — someone who has architected and shipped production AI at scale and understands the deep challenges of building reliable systems on probabilistic foundations. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better.

You embody what we call Evidence Over Ego — you make architectural decisions from evaluation data and evidence rather than hype, you invite rigorous challenge, and you change direction when the models or the data move. You bring systems thinking to a genuinely unsolved problem space and build for durability.

This is the right role if you want to define how AI works on a platform at the center of enterprise revenue.

THE TEAM

The Salesloft AI Engineering organization builds the machine intelligence at the core of the Predictive Revenue System. The team works at the intersection of applied research and production engineering, in close partnership with Product, Data Science, and Data Platform Engineering.

The team Moves as One — AI engineering, product, and data science share ownership of shipping trustworthy AI and make hard technical calls together. And we are relentlessly Customer Inspired: every AI capability is measured against whether it makes revenue teams genuinely more successful and more confident in the system.

THE SKILL SET

  • Extensive experience building and architecting production software systems at scale, with significant depth in AI/ML systems.
  • Hands-on experience building production systems on top of LLMs or machine learning models — including designing for the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, model serving, and the infrastructure required to run AI reliably at scale.
  • Proven experience designing evaluation frameworks, guardrails, or quality systems for AI-driven features.
  • A track record of setting technical architecture and standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers.
  • Strong command of a major programming language (e.g., Python, Java, or Go) and modern cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP).
  • Hands-on experience with agentic systems — designing and hardening AI agents that take autonomous action in production.
  • Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling.

BENEFITS:

For more information about our company's comprehensive benefits please visit: https://salesloftbenefits.com/

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment - all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

#LI-REMOTE

It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.  The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.  

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. 

Base Pay Range$165,000—$185,000 USD

title: Analytics Engineer, Data
description:
Headquarters: Remote (Canada)

Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale 

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer who thrives in high-complexity environments—someone excited to bring clarity to chaos, untangle complex models, and lay down the foundation for scalable solutions.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who isn’t afraid to address manual processes, viewing them as opportunities to build scalable solutions that drive meaningful impact. You’ll work closely with stakeholders across the company to build reliable, trusted data models that support reporting, analysis, and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dive into complex systems and manual workflows to develop an understanding of our tools and constraints.
  • Thoughtfully design and maintain clean, scalable, production-grade dbt models (e.g., ARR, revenue recognition).
  • Work across the full data pipeline, from ingestion to transformation to visualization.
  • Take a pragmatic approach to system challenges, balancing quick fixes with thoughtful long-term design.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Engineering, Sales, and other teams across the company to understand data needs and deliver timely, practical solutions.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience designing and maintaining production-grade data models and pipelines.
  • Deep understanding of modern data modeling principles and best practices.
  • Strong SQL skills and confidence working with complex datasets and schemas.
  • High attention to detail, with high standards for data accuracy and validation.
  • Flexibility and resourcefulness in navigating manual tasks or imperfect systems.
  • Passion for clean code, scalable architecture, and incrementally reducing complexity over time.
  • Ability to manage time, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.
  • Clear communication skills with both technical and non-technical collaborators.
  • Willingness to flexibly support other domains (e.g., Product, Marketing, and Engineering) as the team grows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a high-growth PLG SaaS company.
  • A track record of transforming manual, ad hoc workflows into scalable data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with billing systems, GAAP accounting, revenue recognition, or audit support.
  • Exposure to Stripe, Salesforce, or Orb in billing and finance contexts.
  • Familiarity with financial cycles and the need for fast iteration during month- and quarter-end.

Our Tech Stack

  • Snowflake, dbt, Hightouch, Fivetran, Looker, Stripe, Salesforce, Orb.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

CAN Pay Range$203,680—$254,600 CAD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. 
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! 
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. 
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness.

title: Deployment Architect
description:
Headquarters: Remote (North America)

About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

About The Role 

As an Deployment Architect, you will be the force behind successful deployments at Hightouch. Working in close partnership with an account team and the Hightouch product team, you will own the full deployment and enablement lifecycle for Hightouch customers. You will be the primary point of contact for customers during deployment and are responsible for executing the technical aspects of customer onboarding, ensuring seamless integration of Hightouch into customers' existing data infrastructure.

In this role, you will be the product expert who translates complex customer requirements into actionable implementation plans. You should have a natural ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both data engineering teams and business stakeholders. As the primary owner of the deployment lifecycle, your focus is on creating repeatable, efficient implementation processes that scale across our customer base while maintaining the flexibility to address unique enterprise needs.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive the onboarding process for customers, working closely with the Account team to ensure alignment between technical execution and customer success objectives
  • Design and optimize deployment frameworks that can scale across different customer segments while accommodating enterprise-specific requirements
  • Lead technical discovery sessions and implementation workshops, collaborating with customer data engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for deployments, including integration specifications, data models, and best practices
  • Develop and execute implementation plans that minimize time-to-value while ensuring robust, sustainable solutions
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and resolve technical blockers that could impact customer success
  • Build relationships with technical stakeholders within customer organizations
  • Contribute to product development by providing feedback to our engineering team
  • Standardize and automate implementation processes to increase team efficiency and customer satisfaction

What We're Looking For

  • 5-10 years of experience in technical implementation, solutions architecture, or similar roles with enterprise software
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience in data integration, APIs, and enterprise architecture
  • Proven track record of successfully managing complex technical implementations while maintaining clear communication with a variety of stakeholders
  • The ability to tackle the most ambiguous customer problems (the "that can't be done" ones) and find a creative paths to successful implementation
  • Experience creating and optimizing implementation processes that can scale across an organization
  • Excellence in technical project management with ability to manage multiple concurrent implementations
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills with ability to command a room of technical and business audiences
  • Experience working with data warehouses, ETL processes, and marketing technology is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience)

The salary range for this position is $140,000-$180,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation.

E-Verify Statement

Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

description:
Headquarters: Remote

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for Lithic’s Card Authorization team, which owns the real-time systems that make every card authorization decision correct, reliable, and fast. The team also owns related fraud tooling, including Lithic’s Rules Engine and 3D Secure integration. You’ll own high-impact projects end-to-end, solve distributed-systems problems at scale, and help build the tools customers use to control fraud and payment risk.

What you'll do:

  • Write reliable, secure, scalable code for Lithic’s real-time authorization and fraud-prevention systems with minimal tech debt
  • Build customer-facing features, such as rules improvements, velocity controls, 3DS flows, fraud tooling, and transaction monitoring. Own projects from planning to launch.
  • Improve the reliability of systems in team’s scope and participate in the team on-call rotation
  • Lead efforts to improve systems and processes within the team

What you'll bring:

  • 4+ years building production backend systems. Full stack experience is a plus.
  • Experience in or desire to learn Rust; ability to understand Lithic’s system written in other programming languages (Python, Java)
  • Interest and experience in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, align diverse perspectives, and drive toward practical solutions
  • Experience or interest in payments, fintech, fraud prevention.
  • Comfort with designing systems from scratch and owning the product development process end-to-end
  • Strong written communication skills and experience working in a remote, async-first team that’s spread across time zones

The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 to $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end deployment and migration for enterprise Email/SMS customers, from technical discovery through successful production launch
  • Lead technical discovery and implementation workshops, translating customer requirements into scalable messaging architecture across integrations, data flows, APIs, account structure, and channel configuration
  • Assess customers’ existing ESP and messaging infrastructure and develop migration plans that manage dependencies, mitigate risk, and accelerate time-to-value
  • Drive implementation across technical and business stakeholders, including configuration, integration, testing, validation, cutover, and launch readiness
  • Lead SMS provisioning and implementation, including sender setup and registration, consent and preference flows, and identification of carrier, regulatory, and provisioning dependencies
  • Partner with Deliverability Specialists on sender authentication, domain and IP strategy, warm-up, reputation, and overall deliverability readiness
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, proactively identifying architectural decisions, risks, and blockers throughout the deployment
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to resolve implementation blockers and bring customer feedback and product gaps back into the organization
  • Build repeatable frameworks, documentation, tooling, and best practices that make enterprise deployments more efficient and scalable

What We’re Looking For

  • 5–10 years of experience in technical implementation, solutions architecture, professional services, or a similar customer-facing technical role
  • Experience implementing or migrating enterprise email, SMS, marketing automation, or customer engagement platforms
  • Strong technical foundation across APIs, webhooks, data integrations, authentication, and enterprise architecture
  • Strong understanding of messaging architecture, including sending domains and IPs, subscriber data, consent and preference management, and transactional vs. marketing messaging
  • Experience with SMS provisioning and implementation, including 10DLC, toll-free or short code registration, consent management, and carrier requirements
  • Proven ability to lead complex enterprise implementations across multiple technical teams, business stakeholders, and dependencies

title: People Partner
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

Job: People Partner

Location: United States, Remote 

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY

At Salesloft, our People Partner is a strategic advisor and catalyst for organizational effectiveness. Rather than simply managing HR transactions, you will partner directly with business leaders to align talent strategies with our overarching business objectives. You will act as a trusted coach, a change agent, and a data-driven problem solver who ensures our teams are structured, supported, and engaged to drive consistent growth. While you will oversee complex employee relations, your true impact will be felt in your ability to proactively identify organizational gaps and implement initiatives that elevate our high-performance culture.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Partner with department leaders to design and execute talent strategies, including workforce planning, organizational design, and succession planning.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers, building their capability to lead high-performing, highly engaged teams.
  • Analyze workforce trends and metrics to recommend action plans that improve engagement and retention.
  • Lead change management initiatives to support business transformation, scale, and continuous improvement across your dedicated client groups.
  • Oversee complex employee relations matters, including investigations, ensuring fairness, risk mitigation, and alignment with our core values.
  • Lead the creation and maintenance of company policies, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and company direction.
  • Craft corporate communications that land clearly across all levels of the organization.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will have the opportunity to shape the employee experience for a fast-growing team. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a strategic, commercially-minded HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about contributing to the success of their peers. You excel at looking beyond the symptoms of an organizational issue to diagnose root causes, and you are comfortable challenging leaders with empathy and data. You do not just manage processes; you drive outcomes.

If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming our People Partner is the career path for you!

THE TEAM

Our Salesloft People Business Partner team is a small but mighty group of strategic advisors embedded with the business. We partner with leaders on organizational design, manager capability, and workforce planning, and we turn people data into action so our teams can perform at their best.

As a People Partner, you'll help bring our five core values to life across the business: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, and Customer-Inspired. They shape how we hire, coach, and grow our people every day.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in Human Resources, with a strong background as an HRBP, People Partner, or equivalent strategic role.
  • Demonstrated experience in coaching business leaders, driving organizational design, and leading change management initiatives.
  • Strong ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a high-demand environment with professionalism and good judgment
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with experience interfacing with all levels of an organization
  • High attention to detail and a high degree of empathy in supporting a positive, accommodating employee experience
  • Bachelor's Degree

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting technical or go-to-market teams in a high-growth SaaS environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in leveraging HRIS data to build compelling, data-driven business cases.
  • A passion for teamwork and contributing to the success and reputation of the broader People function.
  • Prior experience in a PE backed organization preferred. 

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you're excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team.

Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Learn more about our full range of benefits at salesloftbenefits.com

 

#LI-Remote

It is Salesloft’s intent to pay all Lofters competitive wages and salaries that are motivational, fair and equitable.  The goal of Salesloft’s compensation program is to be transparent, attract potential employees, meet the needs of all current employees and encourage employees to stay with our organization.  

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

title: Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships
description:
Headquarters: San Diego, CA, USA
URL: http://www.shoutaboutus.com

Technical Account Manager, API Partnerships

Shout About Us · Remote (worldwide) · Full-time · 60K - 80K USD

About the role

We're hiring a Technical Account Manager to own and grow our most strategic accounts. You’ll own the technical relationship with our API partners, from their first technical evaluation through implementation and ongoing support.

Reporting directly to the CRO, you’ll be the first dedicated post-sales professional at Shout About Us, responsible for making sure our biggest customers deploy, expand, and stay. Our ICP is founders, product teams, and engineering teams. 

This is a hands-on role. On any given day, you might join a prospect’s technical discovery call, troubleshoot an API request with a partner engineer, coordinate a fix with our engineering team, or improve a quickstart guide. You’ll also help build the documentation and processes that make each new integration easier than the last.

Location and hours

Remote, anywhere. Our standard working hours are Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–5 p.m. US Eastern Time, including a lunch break. Occasional calls outside these hours are required for APAC partners and key implementation milestones.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of 10-15 strategic accounts. Be the primary technical contact for API partners, keep stakeholders informed, and follow issues through to resolution.

  • Support technical evaluations. Join sales calls, demonstrate API capabilities, understand the partner’s requirements, and explain how an integration would work.

  • Lead partner implementations. Turn requirements into a clear integration plan, guide developers through setup and testing, and track progress through launch.

  • Troubleshoot directly. Investigate requests, responses, logs, authentication issues, and integration behavior before escalating to engineering.

  • Work closely with engineering. Provide clear reproduction steps, relevant evidence, and customer impact when an issue needs deeper investigation.

  • Improve the developer experience. Create and maintain API guides, Postman collections, code examples, FAQs, and onboarding playbooks.

  • Identify recurring friction. Share partner feedback and integration patterns that can inform product improvements.

  • Lead expansion efforts. Cross-sell new features and products as a natural extension of the relationship, not a separate motion. 

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role or equivalent at an API-first or dev-tools company

  • Strong practical understanding of REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, authentication, webhooks, pagination, and rate limits.

  • Comfort using Postman or curl, reading logs, and writing or adapting small code examples in a language such as JavaScript or Python.

  • Experience driving adoption inside complex orgs: navigating the gap between the buyer who signed and the team that deploys

  • Strong follow-through. You keep track of open questions, set expectations, and make sure customers know what happens next.

  • Startup experience at a company under 50 people. There's no support team behind you.

  • Clear written and spoken English. You can explain the same issue to a developer and a nontechnical stakeholder.

  • Owner mentality. "I'll make sure this gets done," not "I passed it to engineering."

Why you should join

  • Own meaningful partner relationships from technical evaluation through launch and beyond.

  • See the impact of your work in successful integrations and better customer experiences.

  • You’ll own and drive every initiative you work on from start to finish. We fully trust you.

  • Work remotely from anywhere while collaborating on a shared schedule.

  • Work directly with the people selling and building the product.

Why you shouldn't join

  • You are not comfortable working without a clear structure and playbook. 

  • You need predictable hours. Most weeks are normal. Go-live weeks and APAC escalations aren't.

Interview process

Our process includes an introductory call, a short written exercise, a practical technical session, and a final conversation with our CEO. We’ll share the details and expected time commitment before each step.

About Shout About Us

Shout About Us is API-first review infrastructure for marketplaces and platforms.

Reviews are the most valuable decision signal in every transaction: which agent, which contractor, which property, which restaurant. Almost every platform that hosts those decisions rents that signal from Google, Trustpilot or Yelp. We give platforms the APIs and infrastructure to own it.

What you can build with our APIs:

  • A verified first-party review engine: collection, verification, moderation and publishing under your brand

  • Third-party review aggregation from Google, Yelp, Facebook and 80+ other sources

  • AI review responses drafted and posted natively, without your customers leaving your platform

  • Review solicitation and surveys triggered from events in your product

  • Flagging, disputes, AI insight reports and competitor analysis

We’re a small team looking for someone who can make it easier for partners to understand, integrate, and succeed with our API.

About the Position

We’re looking for a fully remote Digital Marketing Manager to oversee and execute (with creative support) digital ads, email, and social media across both brands.

This position will own the planning, implementation, copywriting, channel management, budget allocation, partner relationships, and performance reporting.

This role will work very closely with the Marketing & Creative Director and includes direct account management and oversight of external paid media contractors/agencies.

Responsibilities

Paid Acquisition

  • Write copy for ads, landing pages, and other materials
  • Manage budgets across platforms and reallocate based on performance data

  • Manage relationships with partner brands, platforms, and content creators

Email Marketing

  • Manage list segmentation, automations, and lifecycles
  • Test subject lines, creative, timing, and implement findings

Social Media

  • Maintain content calendars for Card Conduit and Spellfinder across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and X/Twitter
  • Write, schedule, and publish biweekly content on each channel, coordinating creative with the M&C Director
  • Monitor and respond to community engagement

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of digital marketing experience with ownership of paid campaigns/email programs

Compensation and Benefits

Along with the starting annual salary range of $80–90,000, Card Conduit offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, access to a 401k with a 100% match up to 5%, 4 paid holidays, 2 floating holidays, and three weeks of PTO accrued over each year.

description:
Headquarters: Belarus
URL: http://flosum.com

Description

SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst — Flosum

About Flosum

Flosum is a Salesforce-native platform company delivering enterprise-grade DevOps, data protection, and security solutions to some of the world's largest organizations. Our product portfolio spans Cloud DevOps, Data Migrator, Data Masking, Data Backup, Org Security, Cloud Trust Center, and Sandbox Synchronization — all built natively on the Salesforce platform. We serve enterprise customers across technology, energy, financial services, healthcare, and federal government. Flosum is a growth-stage company operating with the intensity and speed of a startup backed by the discipline of a mature operator.

The Role

We're hiring a SaaS Revenue & Financial Analyst who will own the measurement layer of our entire business. You will be the person who knows every number — ARR, net retention, expansion, churn, pipeline conversion, cost of acquisition, gross margin by product line, services margin, cash flow, and everything in between. You'll work across Salesforce (our CRM and billing system of record) and QuickBooks (our financial system) to build a unified, always-current picture of company performance.

This is not a reporting role. This is an analytical role where you connect revenue operations data to financial outcomes and surface the insights that drive decisions at the CEO level.

What You'll Own

You will build and maintain our SaaS metrics infrastructure — ARR waterfall, cohort retention analysis, revenue recognition schedules, deferred revenue tracking, and unit economics by segment. You will reconcile Salesforce bookings data against QuickBooks revenue entries and ensure we have a single source of truth across both systems. You will produce monthly and quarterly financial and revenue packages for leadership, including variance analysis against plan. You will model scenarios for pricing changes, product bundling, geographic expansion, and headcount investment. You will monitor pipeline health and translate pipeline data into revenue forecasts with documented assumptions. You will own the data integrity between our CRM and accounting systems, flagging discrepancies before they compound. You will support board-level and investor-level reporting with clean, defensible metrics.



Requirements

What We're Looking For

You have three-plus years of experience in SaaS financial analysis, revenue operations, or FP&A at a B2B software company. You are deeply proficient in Salesforce — not as a user, but as someone who understands opportunity objects, product schedules, contract structures, and reporting at a data level. You are equally proficient in QuickBooks Online, including chart of accounts design, revenue categorization, journal entries, and reconciliation workflows. You understand ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and can apply them to a multi-product SaaS business with annual and multi-year contracts. You can build financial models from scratch in Excel or Google Sheets — not from templates, from logic. You think in terms of cohorts, not just totals. You understand the difference between bookings, billings, and revenue, and you can explain why each matters. You are precise, skeptical of your own numbers, and obsessive about data integrity.

Preferred

Experience at a company with a mix of subscription revenue and professional services. Familiarity with Salesforce CPQ or native Salesforce quoting and contract objects. Exposure to investor or board reporting at a growth-stage company. Experience with Marketo or HubSpot data as it relates to CAC and attribution modeling.

Why Flosum

You'll report directly into the CEO's operating rhythm. Your work will not sit in a queue — it will shape hiring plans, product investment, and go-to-market strategy in real time. Flosum is building the definitive platform for Salesforce lifecycle management, and we need someone who can measure every dimension of that growth with precision.

Vectra® is the leader in AI-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises.

The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber-attacks. With 35 patents in AI-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www.vectra.ai. 

 

If you don't see an open position that aligns with your background, please feel free to join our Talent Community by submitting your resume.

 

Who We Are

At Vectra we seek to make the world a safer and fairer place, build a culture we're proud of and leverage AI to its full potential to do good, We do these things by leveraging our values of Integrity, Teamwork and Customer First.

 

Here is how we define our values:

 

Integrity:

Integrity is our foundation. It drives every decision we make and every action we take. We believe in doing what is right, even when no one is watching. We prioritize honesty, transparency and fairness, earning your trust every step of the way.

Teamwork:

We value teamwork that is focused, efficient and drama-free. We respect and challenge each other to do the best work we can. The collaborative culture we've cultivated means we can accomplish extraordinary feats.

 

Customer First:

For over a decade, we’ve been obsessed with creating what security analysts and SOC leaders have repeatedly told us is most critical: creating the most accurate attack signal. We have teams of security researchers, data scientists and software engineers who are laser focused on perfecting our signal, improving it every day. Our company is committed to providing the best attack signal on the planet, providing an easy-to-use platform and providing white-glove, proactive and responsive service along with shared accountability to make the lives of our customers easier.

Description de poste – Version française 

ICUC est un leader mondial des solutions en médias sociaux depuis plus de 20 ans. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe compte plus de 350 personnes réparties dans plus de 35 pays et couvrant 50 langues, 24 heures sur 24. Dans un environnement où la seule constante, c’est le changement, on crée des ponts entre les marques et leurs publics à travers les communautés et les plateformes sociales. Portés par une culture unique axée sur la méritocratie, on met de l’avant la passion, l’expertise et l’équilibre nécessaires pour atteindre notre objectif : pour être les meilleurs, on s’entoure des meilleurs. Prêt·e à joindre l’équipe d’ICUC? 

Si tu aimes les médias sociaux, que tu as une passion pour l’écriture et que tu sais connecter avec les gens en ligne, on veut te connaître. 

Nous sommes toujours à la recherche de personnes talentueuses pour se joindre à notre équipe. Il s’agit d’une opportunité en candidature continue pour de futurs postes, tu peux donc postuler en tout temps. 

À propos du poste 

Nous sommes une équipe en pleine croissance à la recherche de professionnels bilingues (anglais et français) en gestion des médias sociaux, qui aiment participer à des conversations en ligne, créer du contenu engageant et contribuer à bâtir des communautés numériques sécuritaires et accueillantes. 

Nous cherchons des personnes disponibles pour travailler un mélange des quarts suivants (incluant les fins de semaine) : 

  • Jour : 8 h à 16 h – fuseau horaire central nord-américain 

  • Soir : 16 h à minuit – fuseau horaire central nord-américain 

  • Nuit : minuit à 8 h – fuseau horaire central nord-américain 

Ce poste demande une bonne flexibilité pour travailler différents quarts, incluant soirs et fins de semaine. 

Une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais est essentielle, en plus du français, puisque ce poste implique la gestion de contenus et de comptes en anglais et en français, ainsi qu’une collaboration étroite avec des équipes internationales.

Ce que tu feras au quotidien 

  • Modérer les commentaires et y répondre sur les plateformes sociales des clients, en respectant leur ton et voix de marque. 

  • Rédiger du contenu réfléchi et engageant pour stimuler les conversations et augmenter l’engagement. 

  • Contribuer à maintenir des communautés en ligne sécuritaires, respectueuses et alignées avec les directives des clients. 

  • Identifier et escalader les enjeux, tendances ou insights à l’équipe interne au besoin. 

  • Développer une compréhension solide des marques clientes : stratégie, ton, public cible. 

Ce que tu apportes à l’équipe 

  • Excellentes habiletés en communication écrite (orthographe, grammaire, clarté) en anglais et français, avec une forte sensibilité culturelle. 

  • Expérience en gestion de plateformes sociales, particulièrement en modération et interaction. 

  • Capacité à écrire pour des marques et à adapter le ton selon l’audience. 

  • Connaissance des principales plateformes (Facebook, etc.) — un compte personnel pourrait être requis selon les besoins du client. 

  • Confort à interagir avec une variété de sujets (technologie, commerce de détail, alimentation, hôtellerie, tourisme, santé, pharmaceutique, etc.). 

  • Excellentes aptitudes organisationnelles, fiabilité et sens du service à la clientèle. 

  • Accès à une connexion Internet haute vitesse fiable pour le travail à distance. 

Pourquoi travailler avec nous 

  • 100 % télétravail dès le premier jour 

  • Faire partie d’une équipe créative, solidaire et collaborative 

  • Travailler avec des marques internationales stimulantes 

  • Contribuer à une culture axée sur les gens, l’authenticité et l’inclusion 

Informations Supplémentaires

Une gamme d’avantages médicaux, dentaires, d'un REER, de congés payés et/ou d’autres avantages est également offerte à tous les employés rémunérés à l’heure travaillant au moins 22 heures par semaine.

URL: http://epam.com

We are looking for a Senior VMware Engineer to join our team supporting the delivery of a Unified Automation Platform for a large enterprise client.

Within this role, you will develop and maintain VMware automation modules as part of an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that standardizes project delivery, consolidates development resources, and ensures consistent provisioning across Azure and on-premises VMware environments. Your work will involve a modern toolchain built on Terraform/OpenTofu and Ansible, leveraging AI-assisted development with GitHub Copilot as a standard engineering practice.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Terraform/OpenTofu modules for vSphere VM provisioning, placement/resource-pool configuration, and cloud-init/cloudbase-init integration, following designs defined by the VMware Architect
  • Create and run Ansible playbooks for post-provisioning configuration handoff on VMware-provisioned VMs
  • Provide VMware DRS (affinity/anti-affinity rules, resource pools) and vSAN (storage policy) modules
  • Assist with SRM (protection groups, recovery plans) and HCX (site pairing, network extension) module builds and test-cycle execution, including paired-site and failover testing
  • Collaborate with the Network Architect on NSX-T segment and DFW rule implementation for VMware workloads
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues across VMware automation modules during Implementation and Adoption phases
  • Participate in module testing and documentation per the platform's Infrastructure as Code Engine standards

description:
Headquarters: Kaupmehe 7 Tallinn, 10114 Estonia
URL: http://ilogos.biz

iLogos Game Studios provides solutions for mobile game developers no matter how challenging the project or task is. We’ve been around since 2006 and in that time frame, we have successfully completed 400+ projects and have become a partner of choice for EA, Sony, Disney, Rovio, Ubisoft, and many other companies.

About the project:
This is the next generation of multiplayer gaming, transforming classic poker into an immersive digital spectacle. An interactive competitive platform where players, spectators, and hosts become full-fledged participants in one large-scale shared experience.

At the heart of the project is the concept of the Digital Coliseum — a digital arena where every game becomes a public performance, and audience attention becomes the platform’s most valuable asset and the foundation of its in-game economy.

About the Role

We’re looking for a 2D Artist to help shape the visual world of a mobile poker game set in a high-life solarpunk future — a stylish, technologically advanced, optimistic vision of tomorrow.

You’ll create a wide range of UI elements, game props, customization assets, and thematic visual sets while working within an established art direction. The key challenge is maintaining a strong and consistent visual language across a large amount of diverse content.

The ideal candidate understands how to build assets as part of a cohesive visual system, rather than treating each asset as a standalone illustration. The style should feel premium, futuristic, refined, and sophisticated, with a strong solarpunk influence — without visual clutter.

Requirements:

  • Strong understanding of form, color, materials, composition, and stylization.

  • Ability to work confidently within an established art direction and visual language.

  • Experience creating game UI, props, icons, customization assets, or casual/mobile game art.

  • Strong sense of visual consistency and attention to detail.

  • Ability to create diverse assets that still feel like part of the same game world and visual system.

  • Understanding of how to keep interfaces clean, readable, and visually balanced, even with a large amount of customization content.

  • Ability to work independently from briefs and effectively incorporate feedback from an Art Director.

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating relevant 2D game art and/or UI work.

Key Duties:

  • Create 2D UI and in-game visual elements for a mobile poker game.

  • Design props and customization assets for player profiles, avatars, poker tables, and the game environment.

  • Create playing cards, card backs, chips, table elements, accessories, rewards, status elements, and other game assets.

  • Develop themed visual sets that can transform the overall look of cards, tables, UI, and the game screen around a single theme.

  • Explore shapes, materials, colors, and details within the established high-life solarpunk / futuristic visual language.

  • Maintain a consistent level of quality and visual cohesion across a large volume of assets.

  • Work from art briefs and collaborate closely with the Art Director and UI/UX team.

  • Take assets through to a polished, production-ready state.

Working conditions:

Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well:

  • Work remotely from anywhere in the world;

  • Flexible working hours.

title: Brand Design Manager
description:
Headquarters: Armenia Yerevan, EMEA, Armenia
URL: http://replika.com

About Replika

Replika is an AI companion loved by 35M+ users around the world. We’re redefining what it means to connect with technology – emotionally, intelligently, and personally. From mobile to VR, we’re building an experience that feels less like software and more like someone who gets you.

We’re scaling fast and taking on bold challenges to become the most human AI on the planet.

About the role

Brand Design Manager

We’re building a brand-new product from scratch, and we need someone to design what it actually is — not the buttons, the product. This is a conceptual role: you invent the functions, the moments, the way the whole thing works and feels, from a blank page. You’re not polishing UI. You’re deciding what the product does and why it matters in someone’s life. Move fast, ship working concepts, learn, and go again. We care less about a perfect pixel and more about ideas nobody else would have had.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design the product itself, not just the interface — the functions, the experience, the way it works, invented from a blank page.

  • Turn our AI and technical capabilities into functions that actually change someone’s day — their outlook, perspective, productivity, or the experiences they have.

  • Bring the ideas. Unique concepts, new mechanics, things that don’t exist yet. This role lives or dies on originality.

  • Ship working concepts fast. A rough thing people can feel beats a beautiful deck describing it. Prototype, test, learn, repeat.

  • Hold the “one of a kind” bar — reject the obvious, the derivative, the good-enough, and push for the version only this product could be.

  • Work directly with product, engineering, and the founders to take a concept from idea to something real in the product.

What We’re Looking For

  • A concept-first designer. You design what a product does and how it feels, not just how it looks. You’ve invented product experiences, not just executed someone else’s spec.

  • Genuinely original ideas. You can point to things you’ve made that were new — concepts other people hadn’t thought of, that actually worked.

  • A deep sense for great products. You know what makes something amazing and one of a kind versus competent and forgettable, and you can say exactly why.

  • You turn capability into meaning. Handed a raw technical ability — say, a new AI capability — you can see the function it should become, the one that improves a user’s life.

  • A bias for speed. You ship working concepts fast and learn from them. You don’t disappear for weeks to perfect a pixel.

  • Comfortable at ground zero. Blank page, no patterns, no spec — that’s where you do your best work.

  • Hands-on and self-directed. You bring the ideas and drive them. Nobody’s hovering.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AI, conversational, or emotionally engaging products — turning novel technology into human experiences.

  • You’ve taken a product concept from nothing to something people actually used and loved.

  • A body of work that shows range and originality — concepts, prototypes, products — not just screens.

  • You prototype in whatever gets the idea across fastest: Figma, motion, code, paper, Keynote, whatever works.

  • You already use AI tools to explore ideas and move faster.

What You’ll Get

  • Competitive compensation.

  • Flexible job schedule and generous vacation policy.

  • Unlimited access to the latest AI coding assistants.

  • No corporate bs.

  • Direct impact on millions of worldwide users within months.

  • Push the boundaries of applied AI in a consumer setting.

  • Fully remote.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/replika-brand-design-manager

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Belarus
URL: http://epam.com

We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join our engagement on the delivery of a Unified Automation Platform — an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that standardizes new-project delivery, centralizes access to development resources, and enables software creation through templates and golden paths.

In this role, you will contribute to the Network/Firewalls automation stream, building modules on a modern toolchain (Terraform/OpenTofu for IaC and Ansible for CaC) with AI-assisted development using GitHub Copilot as a standard practice.

Responsibilities

  • Implement and maintain firewall automation modules across PaloAlto, F5, and Cloudflare (security rules, address/service objects, NAT, VIP/pool configuration, WAF policy, certificate binding), following designs defined by the Network Architect
  • Build and maintain DNS and NetBox IPAM automation (zone/record management, prefix/role/tenant data entry, reconciliation jobs)
  • Deliver Azure core connectivity modules (VNets/subnets, Application Gateway, WAF, Azure Firewall, NSGs) via Terraform/OpenTofu
  • Support VMware NSX-T segment and distributed firewall (DFW) rule implementation in coordination with the VMware team
  • Execute commit/lock handling procedures for concurrent firewall pipeline changes (PaloAlto/Panorama candidate-config workflows)
  • Troubleshoot and remediate production network/firewall issues during Implementation and Adoption, working within change-control processes given the high blast-radius of network changes

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in network engineering with a focus on automation
  • Background in automating firewall platforms via Infrastructure as Code, including PaloAlto, F5, and Cloudflare
  • Expertise in implementing Azure networking constructs (VNets, Application Gateway, WAF) and security components (Azure Firewall, NSGs) via Terraform/OpenTofu
  • Knowledge of DNS and IPAM (NetBox) data models and automation
  • Familiarity with VMware NSX-T network segmentation and distributed firewall concepts
  • Proficiency in Ansible for network/firewall configuration tasks, combined with Terraform/OpenTofu-based provisioning
  • Capability to operate within change-control processes for high-blast-radius network/security modifications
  • Flexibility to use AI-assisted development with GitHub Copilot (provided project-wide)
  • Excellent command of written and spoken English (B2+ level)

Nice to have

  • Skills in certificate distribution (Venafi) tied to network/load-balancer endpoints
  • Exposure to global traffic management and multi-region failover patterns

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/epam-systems-senior-network-engineer

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: http://onthegosystems.com

At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML, Toolset, and PTC, we’re looking for a hands-on, AI-native marketer who wants to take ownership of marketing and help shape how we do it.

AI is a core part of how we work. We’re looking for someone who already uses AI agents, automation, integrations, and structured workflows to get real marketing work done – and can show us what they’ve achieved with them.

This is also a technical role. We’ve built our own analytics, newsletter, and marketing automation systems, so you should be comfortable working with technical tools, setting up a local development environment, and using tools like Claude to help you navigate technical tasks.

You won’t be joining an established marketing team or following a fixed playbook. You’ll have the freedom to talk to our clients, understand our business, find the strongest opportunities, and decide what marketing should focus on next.

What You’ll Work On

Several areas currently need an owner:

  • SEO / GEO / AEO

  • Content and collaborations with partners, authors, and bloggers

  • Marketing to existing customers, including retention and expansion

  • Paid advertising

  • Client analytics

  • Other marketing opportunities you identify

You’ll work hands-on, from identifying an opportunity through execution, measurement, and improvement.

Your First Weeks

We don’t expect you to arrive with all the answers. We want you to understand the business first and then decide what should be done.

You’ll:

  • Learn our products, industry, competitors, and ecosystem.

  • Speak directly with customers to understand their needs and how they see our products.

  • Look at our data, existing activities, and opportunities.

  • Identify where marketing can have the biggest impact.

  • Build a concrete plan for the areas you propose to own and explain why.

What We’re Looking For

  • You already use AI agents, automation, and advanced AI workflows in your everyday work and can show us concrete results.

  • You’re hands-on and comfortable with the technical side of marketing.

  • You’re curious and take time to understand customers and the business before proposing solutions.

  • You can work across different areas of marketing and turn ideas into action.

  • You understand how marketing connects to business results.

  • You have experience marketing technical products, ideally software, SaaS, WordPress, or similar.

  • You work independently and can move things forward without detailed instructions.

  • You’re comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change and not everything is defined in advance.

Why Join Us

OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007. WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide.

You’ll have real ownership and the freedom to help build our marketing approach, work directly with our CEO and product teams, experiment with AI, and turn your ideas into real marketing initiatives.

We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life.

If you’re excited about building marketing with AI, getting hands-on, and having the freedom to shape what comes next, we’d love to hear from you.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-marketing-1

The Position

The Coordinator, Payroll Client Services is responsible for resolving customer payroll inquiries and supporting smooth payroll operations. The role focuses on learning payroll processes, mastering support workflows, and resolving standard client issues efficiently. Coordinators rely heavily on documentation and established escalation paths while developing foundational payroll expertise. Success at this level requires strong attention to detail, clear communication with customers, and the ability to follow structured operational processes. As Coordinators gain experience, they are expected to resolve a broader range of payroll inquiries independently and deepen their understanding of payroll systems and regulations.

Responsibilities

Client Issue Resolution

  • Resolve customer inquiries related to payroll processing, discrepancies, and platform usage.
  • Ensure timely responses via email, chat, phone, and other channels that meet service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Handle customer inquiries according to defined workflows and expectations, such as Remote values and Remote Customer Code.
  • Gather necessary information to diagnose payroll issues accurately using the available tools, documentation and customer information.
  • Escalate complex cases to senior team members following defined workflows.
  • Document issue details and resolution steps clearly.

Customer Communication

  • Provide timely updates to customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines.
  • Clarify customer questions related to payroll processes or platform functionality in customer understandable terms.
  • Maintain professionalism and clarity in all written and verbal communication with customers.

Operational Process Execution

  • Follow internal workflows and support documentation to resolve cases consistently.
  • Ensure accurate documentation of support tickets and case outcomes.
  • Adhere to defined SLAs and operational guidelines.

Learning & Knowledge Development

  • Identify and bring up recurring issues or gaps in documentation or processes to help improve team efficiency.
  • Build foundational understanding of payroll concepts and processes.
  • Learn payroll rules and compliance considerations in supported regions.
  • Seek guidance from senior team members when encountering unfamiliar issues.

 

Practicals

  • Direct reports: No
  • Team: Customer Experience - Payroll Client Services
  • Location: Indonesia
  • Start date: As soon as possible

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness.
